name: Belpoint Strait
summary: A deep dive site off Belpoint holding five of Kenton's treasures, with no shipwreck.
body: Push Square places the Belpoint Strait just off the southern tip of Belpoint in Mariana County, west of Bobcat Bight, and says there is no shipwreck but the dive is deep.
Push Square lists 5 treasures there: Ancient Bracelet, Ancient Ingot, Avian Plate, Golden Fish and Lover's Grail.
Push Square says the site does not count toward the 33 Underwater Discoveries, and that scuba gear (from Island Dreams or either boat) is needed.

name: Bobcat Dive Site
summary: A dive site west of Bobcat Key holding six of Kenton's treasures, with no shipwreck.
body: Push Square places the Bobcat Dive Site west of Bobcat Key in Mariana County, on the south-western side of the map, and says there is no shipwreck, only underwater scenery.
Push Square lists 6 treasures there: Astrolabe, Captain's Whistle, Ceramic Pirate, Ivory Sundial, Naval Hourglass and Pirate's Buckle.
Push Square says the site does not count toward the 33 Underwater Discoveries, and that scuba gear (from Island Dreams or either boat) is needed.

name: Ancient Bracelet
summary: A Kenton's Treasure found at the Belpoint Strait dive site, the southern tip of Belpoint.
body: Push Square lists the Ancient Bracelet among the 5 treasures at the Belpoint Strait, a dive site with no shipwreck in Mariana County.
Push Square says Kenton's treasures are found with the Metal Detector while diving with scuba gear, that Kenton pays little per item at first, and that a completed set earns a bigger payout.
